annotations.title: Height of an object seen by several witnesses

description: Estimate the height and distance of one object seen at the same moment by 2 to 6 witnesses, from each witness's position and line of sight, with a height range covering typical compass errors. Use it only when several people measured the same object at the same time; for a single witness use identify or what_did_i_see. Local geometry, no network call; the result is a candidate, never a proof.

sightings.description: 2 to 6 sightings, each {lat, lon, az, el}: witness position and measured direction of the object.

name: triangulate

outputSchema.description: Returns status (candidate | baseline_too_short | no_intersection), height_m, height_range_m_if_sightings_off_by_2deg, distance_from_witnesses_m, quality, interpretation.

title: Height of an object seen by several witnesses
